_about: AAMC content categories for each in-scope MCAT topic, with what the exam actually tests there. Read by hand before classification; it is the exam-weight input the original card generation never had.

mcat-anatomy-physiology-embryology-mcat.tested: Fertilization through gastrulation, germ-layer derivatives, induction, determination vs differentiation, neurulation.

mcat-anatomy-physiology-mcat.tested: Cross-system integration: homeostasis, feedback, skin/thermoregulation, digestive absorption sites, blood composition.

mcat-anatomy-physiology-musculoskeletal-.tested: Sarcomere and sliding-filament mechanism, Ca2+/troponin, muscle fiber types, bone remodeling and Ca2+ regulation, joints.

mcat-anatomy-physiology-reproductive-mca.tested: Gametogenesis, menstrual cycle hormones and feedback (LH surge), spermatogenesis, sex determination, pregnancy hormones.

mcat-anatomy-physiology-sensory-mcat.tested: Transduction in vision, hearing and balance, photoreceptors, cochlea, receptor types, thresholds; sensory pathways to cortex. Note: the deck also holds three autonomic nervous-system cards that belong to the endocrine/nervous topic.

mcat-cell-biology-cell-cycle-mcat.tested: Cell-cycle phases, checkpoints, cyclins/CDKs at the conceptual level, mitosis vs meiosis outcomes, apoptosis vs necrosis, oncogenes and tumor suppressors.

mcat-cell-biology-mcat.tested: Cell theory, prokaryote vs eukaryote, membrane structure, cytoskeleton, extracellular matrix, cell junctions.

mcat-cell-biology-membrane-transport-mca.tested: Passive vs active transport, osmosis and tonicity, Na+/K+ ATPase, membrane potential, endo/exocytosis.

mcat-cell-biology-organelles-mcat.tested: Function of each organelle, endomembrane trafficking, mitochondria and endosymbiosis, lysosomes and peroxisomes.

mcat-cell-biology-signaling-mcat.tested: Receptor classes (GPCR, RTK, ligand-gated, intracellular), second messengers (cAMP, IP3/Ca2+), signal amplification and termination.

mcat-genetics-evolution-immunology-mcat.tested: Innate vs adaptive immunity, B and T cell roles, antibody structure, MHC I/II, vaccination, hypersensitivity basics. The deck also carries a few 1C genetics/evolution cards under its parent slug; judge those on 1C merit.

mcat-genetics-evolution-mcat.tested: Despite its row name, this deck holds evolution/phylogeny, Hardy-Weinberg/drift and epistasis/linkage/pedigree cards that belong to its three subtopics, plus mitochondrial inheritance and imprinting. Judge on 1C merit.

mcat-genetics-evolution-mendelian-mcat.tested: Mendel's laws, Punnett squares and ratios, pedigrees, X-linkage, linkage and recombination, incomplete dominance, epistasis, penetrance.

mcat-genetics-evolution-natural-selectio.tested: Fitness and selection types, speciation and isolation, adaptive radiation, evidence for evolution, punctuated vs gradual.

mcat-genetics-evolution-population-genet.tested: Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium and its uses, allele-frequency calculations, drift, bottleneck/founder effects, gene flow, inbreeding.

mcat-microbiology-antimicrobials-mcat.tested: Antibiotic classes by target (cell wall, ribosome, DNA), selective toxicity, resistance mechanisms and their spread.

mcat-microbiology-bacteria-mcat.tested: Bacterial structure and shapes, Gram staining, growth curve, binary fission, metabolism (aerobe/anaerobe), endospores, flagella.

mcat-microbiology-genetics-mcat.tested: Transformation, transduction, conjugation, plasmids, transposons, and how they move resistance.

mcat-microbiology-mcat.tested: Overview of prokaryotes, archaea, fungi and viruses; normal flora; the distinctions the exam draws between them.

mcat-microbiology-viruses-mcat.tested: Viral structure, lytic vs lysogenic cycles, retroviruses and reverse transcriptase, +/- sense RNA, bacteriophages, prions.

mcat-molecular-biology-biotechnology-mca.tested: PCR, gel electrophoresis, blotting, DNA sequencing, restriction enzymes and cloning, cDNA libraries, CRISPR at the concept level.

mcat-molecular-biology-dna-replication-m.tested: Semiconservative replication, polymerases and their directionality, Okazaki fragments, telomeres, mismatch and excision repair.

mcat-molecular-biology-mcat.tested: DNA and RNA structure, central dogma, chromatin, the genetic code, mutations and their consequences.

mcat-molecular-biology-transcription-mca.tested: RNA polymerase and promoters, capping/splicing/poly-A, operons, eukaryotic regulation (enhancers, transcription factors, epigenetics).

mcat-molecular-biology-translation-mcat.tested: Ribosome structure and stages, tRNA and codon/anticodon, wobble, post-translational modifications, protein targeting.

mcat-organ-systems-cardiovascular-mcat.tested: Cardiac cycle and conduction, blood pressure and flow, oxygen transport and the Hb curve, hemostasis, capillary exchange.

mcat-organ-systems-endocrine-nervous-mca.tested: Hormone classes and mechanisms, hypothalamic-pituitary axes and feedback, neuron structure, action potentials, synapses, autonomic division.

mcat-organ-systems-mcat.tested: Digestive, lymphatic and integumentary systems; enzyme and hormone control of digestion; integration across systems.

mcat-organ-systems-renal-mcat.tested: Nephron regions and what each does, filtration/reabsorption/secretion, countercurrent multiplier, ADH/aldosterone/RAAS, acid-base handling.

mcat-organ-systems-respiratory-mcat.tested: Ventilation mechanics, gas exchange and partial pressures, CO2 transport, control of breathing, respiratory acid-base compensation.

mcat-biochemistry-amino-acids-proteins-m.tested: The 20 amino acids and their side-chain classes, pKa and isoelectric point, peptide bonds, four levels of structure, folding and denaturation.

mcat-biochemistry-bioenergetics-mcat.tested: ATP and phosphoryl transfer, delta G and coupling, electron transport chain complexes, proton gradient and ATP synthase, uncouplers.

mcat-biochemistry-carbohydrate-metabolis.tested: Glycolysis and its regulation, gluconeogenesis, glycogen, pentose phosphate pathway, TCA cycle, fed vs fasting control.

mcat-biochemistry-enzymes-kinetics-mcat.tested: Michaelis-Menten and Lineweaver-Burk, Km and Vmax, inhibition types, allosteric regulation, cofactors, enzyme classes.

mcat-biochemistry-foundations-mcat.tested: Biomolecule classes, thermodynamics of biological reactions, water and pH, carbohydrates and lipids structure.

mcat-biochemistry-lipid-metabolism-mcat.tested: Beta-oxidation, ketogenesis and ketone use, fatty acid synthesis, lipoproteins and cholesterol transport, hormonal control.

mcat-biological-basis-behavior-mcat.tested: Nervous-system organization for behavior, neurotransmitters and their behavioral roles, brain regions, endocrine effects on behavior, genetics of behavior.

mcat-psychology-behavior-cognition-langu.tested: Cognition and problem solving, heuristics and biases, intelligence, consciousness and sleep, language development and brain areas.

mcat-psychology-behavior-development-mca.tested: Piaget, Erikson, Kohlberg, Vygotsky; attachment; personality theories and traits; identity formation.

mcat-psychology-behavior-disorders-mcat.tested: Major disorder categories and defining features, biological bases of schizophrenia and depression, classification approach.

mcat-psychology-behavior-learning-memory.tested: Classical and operant conditioning and their schedules, observational learning, memory encoding/storage/retrieval, forgetting, memory disorders.

mcat-psychology-behavior-mcat.tested: Emotion theories, stress and its physiology, motivation theories, attitudes and behavior.

mcat-psychology-behavior-sensation-perce.tested: Thresholds and signal detection, Weber's law, sensory adaptation, Gestalt principles, bottom-up vs top-down processing, perception of depth and motion.

mcat-social-psychology-mcat.tested: Attribution, conformity and obedience, group dynamics, prejudice and stereotypes, attraction, altruism, aggression.

mcat-sociology-culture-socialization-mca.tested: Socialization agents, culture and norms, deviance theories, social control.

mcat-sociology-groups-interaction-mcat.tested: Status and roles, impression management, dramaturgy, group types and networks, social institutions.

mcat-sociology-health-disparities-mcat.tested: Social determinants of health, disparities by class/race/gender, healthcare access, epidemiology basics as they appear on the exam.

mcat-sociology-mcat.tested: Sociological theories (functionalism, conflict, symbolic interactionism), demographics, urbanization, social movements.

mcat-sociology-structure-stratification-.tested: Social class and mobility, capital types, poverty, stratification theories, intersectionality.

mcat-general-chemistry-acid-base-equilib.tested: pH/pKa and Henderson-Hasselbalch, buffers, titration curves, Ka/Kb, equilibrium constants and Le Chatelier.

mcat-general-chemistry-atomic-structure-.tested: Electron configuration, quantum numbers, periodic trends (radius, ionization energy, electronegativity), bonding types, VSEPR.

mcat-general-chemistry-kinetics-mcat.tested: Rate laws and orders from data, Arrhenius/activation energy, catalysts, rate-determining step, half-life for first order.

mcat-general-chemistry-mcat.tested: Catch-all general chemistry: solutions and colligative properties, gases, redox basics, phase diagrams.

mcat-general-chemistry-stoichiometry-mca.tested: Moles and limiting reagent, percent yield, balancing including redox, oxidation states, reaction types.

mcat-general-chemistry-thermodynamics-mc.tested: Enthalpy, entropy, Gibbs free energy and spontaneity, Hess's law, heat capacity/calorimetry, state functions.

mcat-lab-methods-mcat.tested: Separations (extraction, distillation, chromatography, electrophoresis), purification, safety; interpretation more than procedure.

mcat-organic-chemistry-carbonyls-mcat.tested: Nucleophilic addition to aldehydes/ketones, alpha-carbon chemistry, aldol, carboxylic acid derivatives and their reactivity order.

mcat-organic-chemistry-functional-groups.tested: Recognizing functional groups, IUPAC naming basics, acidity of alcohols/phenols/carboxylic acids, alcohol reactions.

mcat-organic-chemistry-mcat.tested: Catch-all organic: bonding/hybridization, resonance, acid-base, amino-acid-adjacent organic chemistry.

mcat-organic-chemistry-sn1-sn2-e1-e2-mca.tested: SN1/SN2/E1/E2 mechanisms, substrate/nucleophile/solvent effects, stereochemical outcome, carbocation stability.

mcat-organic-chemistry-spectroscopy-mcat.tested: IR characteristic peaks, 1H NMR (shift, splitting, integration), mass spec basics, UV-Vis conjugation.

mcat-organic-chemistry-stereochemistry-m.tested: Chirality and R/S, enantiomers vs diastereomers, meso, optical activity, E/Z, conformations.

mcat-physics-electricity-circuits-mcat.tested: Ohm's law, series/parallel resistors and capacitors, power, Kirchhoff's rules, RC qualitative behavior.

mcat-physics-electricity-electrochemistr.tested: Galvanic vs electrolytic cells, standard reduction potentials and cell EMF, Nernst qualitatively, Faraday's law.

mcat-physics-electricity-electrostatics-.tested: Coulomb's law, electric field and potential, work in fields, capacitors and dielectrics, equipotentials.

mcat-physics-electricity-magnetism-mcat.tested: Magnetic force on moving charges and wires (F = qvB), right-hand rules, induction qualitatively.

mcat-physics-electricity-mcat.tested: Catch-all electricity and light: current, resistance, EM spectrum, wave basics.

mcat-physics-electricity-optics-mcat.tested: Snell's law and total internal reflection, thin lenses and mirrors (1/f equation, sign conventions), magnification, diffraction/polarization basics.

mcat-physics-mechanics-fluids-waves-mcat.tested: Density and pressure, buoyancy, continuity and Bernoulli, Poiseuille qualitatively; wave properties, sound intensity and Doppler, standing waves.

mcat-physics-mechanics-forces-newton-law.tested: Newton's laws, free-body diagrams, friction, inclined planes, tension, circular motion, torque and equilibrium.

mcat-physics-mechanics-kinematics-mcat.tested: Kinematic equations, vectors, projectile motion, graphs of motion, free fall.

mcat-physics-mechanics-mcat.tested: Catch-all mechanics: units and dimensional analysis, vectors, basic energy and force problems.

mcat-physics-mechanics-momentum-collisio.tested: Momentum conservation, impulse, elastic vs inelastic collisions, center of mass.

mcat-physics-mechanics-work-energy-power.tested: Work, kinetic and potential energy, conservation of energy, power, work-energy theorem, simple machines/mechanical advantage.

mcat-cars-passages-comparative-mcat.tested: CARS is a reasoning skill, not content. Cards here are strategy: how a passage-based question type is recognized and attacked. Judge by whether the tactic is used on nearly every passage (ULTRA_HIGH/HIGH) versus a niche question type or generic advice (MEDIUM/LOW). This deck: comparative passages.
